_simple_explanation: This file contains the fixed Week 5 assignment, evidence, candidate runs, rates, and quality gate used by the testbench.

assignment.problem: Improve the fictional intake workflow using approved evidence.
assignment.intended_result: Recommend a source-backed improvement approach with implementation steps and risks.
constraints: Use only the supplied synthetic evidence.

evidence.title: Fictional Intake Baseline
evidence.text: The fictional intake workflow averages 9 business days of cycle time. Staff report duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing.

evidence.title: Fictional Intake Baseline Duplicate
evidence.text: The fictional intake workflow averages 9 business days of cycle time. Staff report duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing.

evidence.title: Fictional Intake Pilot
evidence.text: A prior fictional pilot used a standardized checklist and triage step. The pilot ran for 6 weeks. Success measures included cycle time, rework count, and routing accuracy.

evidence.title: Fictional Historical Cost
evidence.text: A fictional comparable engagement recorded 12000 USD in actual payments during FY2026.

sections.name: findings
sections.content: The intake workflow averages 9 business days of cycle time and has duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing.

sections.name: alternatives
sections.content: Alternative one is a standardized checklist. Alternative two combines the checklist with a triage step.

sections.name: recommendation
sections.content: Use the prior pilot approach as the initial improvement option.

sections.name: implementation_steps
sections.content: Run a 6 week pilot using the checklist and triage step, then measure cycle time, rework count, and routing accuracy.

sections.name: risks
sections.content: Duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing may continue if the checklist and triage step are not applied consistently.

missing_information: Real staffing capacity and City reviewer feedback are not present in this fixture.
expert_review_needed: Operational feasibility should be reviewed by a knowledgeable reviewer.
